evidence: createServer() builds InMemoryUserRepository, InMemoryProjectRepository and InMemoryTaskRepository and passes them into TaskService. This is dependency wiring, an infrastructure job.
app.use(express.json()), app.use(controller.router()) and app.use(controller.errorHandler.bind(controller)) set up the Express framework, which is transport work for infrastructure.
The require.main === module block reads process.env.PORT and calls listen(). This is process and runtime bootstrapping, an infrastructure job.
No domain rules or business decisions appear anywhere in the file.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/infrastructure/server.ts is a composition root and the server's entry point. It builds the in-memory repositories and passes them into TaskService. It also sets up Express middleware, the router and the error handler, reads the port from an environment variable and starts the HTTP listener. Wiring, transport setup, framework setup and process bootstrapping are all infrastructure jobs. The file has no business rules, domain validation or application workflow logic. Those stay behind TaskService and TaskController. No ADR prose was given.
